description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class 'LangTextTest' which tests the functionality of the 'LangText' class related to language string translations within the SuiteCRM project. It sets up language strings, runs various translation lookups, and asserts expected behaviors, including handling missing keys and translation modes.

classes.name: LangTextTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LangText class's translation functionalities within the SuiteCRM framework.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by defining 'sugarEntry', including necessary language files, utility scripts, and classes.

methods.name: testConstruct
methods.description: Performs multiple assertions to verify the correct behavior of LangText translation retrieval under different modes and error conditions.
